entries.title: Track fabrication time
entries.description: Record fabrication start and finish dates, confirm the crew, and correct mistakes from each job. Overdue reminders help ensure completed work is captured.

entries.title: Review product build times
entries.description: Compare scheduled and actual fabrication days for each product, with averages across completed builds. Administrators can also review averages by fabricator.

entries.title: Spot new job activity
entries.description: The navigation now highlights unread job activity and clears the indicator after you view the main activity feed.

entries.title: Price purchase orders faster
entries.description: New lines on draft purchase orders now start with the part’s current average cost, including orders raised from the buy list. Prices remain editable before sending.

entries.title: Estimate plate stock between counts
entries.description: Set an average utilization percentage for periodic plate parts to see estimated whole plates and the remaining open plate in stock lists and stocktake reports. These estimates also improve buy-list recommendations.

entries.title: Track fabrication time
entries.description: Start and finish fabrication, confirm the crew, and correct timing details directly from a job.

entries.title: Spot new job activity
entries.description: The Activity tab now shows an unread indicator when new job updates arrive and clears it after you view the feed.

entries.title: Scan records more easily
entries.description: Jobs, quotes, units, and inventory cards now use clearer Stock labels and more consistent status badges, wording, and spacing.

entries.title: Check estimated plate stock
entries.description: Part details now show estimated whole plates and the remaining open plate for periodic stock configured with an average utilization percentage.
